Priya Nair: Quick update — we're launching a short cross-functional rotation pilot (XFR) across Product, CS, and Platform starting May 18. This is to surface growth paths and improve domain knowledge across teams.
Priya Nair: As part of that, Alex Chen will step in as Interim Head of Customer Engagement for the next 3 months while we run a backfill and evaluate permanent structure. Please cc your handoffs to Alex.
Alex Chen: Thanks team — excited to help. I'll be keeping days for 1:1s with current CE leads. Ping me for critical handoffs.
Jordan Kim: Willing to help align product roadmap priorities with CE during the interim. @Alex can you share a quick list of focus areas?
Alex Chen: Sure — short list: onboarding funnels, latency regressions impacting SLAs, major enterprise accounts needing dedicated support. I'll post details in the doc by EOD.
Samir Patel: Quick Q — will the interim role change comp/band for the person who backfills? Asking for folks considering the rotation.
Priya Nair: Short answer: no immediate comp changes for rotations. Permanent promotions/backfills will follow normal review cadence. Recruiting will share official guidelines.
Recruiting: We'll post the backfill job description tomorrow — goal to have interviews started in 2 weeks.
Lina Chavez: Thanks @Priya and @Alex — can we add a short overlap week for knowledge transfer? Preferably 5 working days.
Alex Chen: Absolutely. Planning a 5-day handoff window; will coordinate calendars this week.
People Ops Bot: Reminder: XFR sign-ups close in 7 days. Signup form: https://bit.ly/redwood-xfr-signup
Priya Nair: For managers — please approve time-off requests for rotation participants if needed, and flag escalation paths. I'll host a 30m Q&A tomorrow at 10am PT: <calendar invite link>
Samir Patel: Thanks. Also can we ensure SRE has a point of contact for any incident ownership during handoffs?
Jordan Kim: I'll add an incident-aware escalation doc to the CE folder.
Alex Chen: Posting initial handoff checklist:
```
- Current customer SLOs
- Open escalations and assignees
- On-call rotation details
- Active roadmap tickets and owners
- Admin access and docs
```
Alex Chen: If anyone has objections to the interim arrangement, DM me or @Priya. Otherwise we'll execute this week. :party:
Priya Nair: Appreciate everyone's flexibility. We'll share a short retrospective after the pilot to decide on broader rollout.
Lina Chavez: Welcome @Alex — and thanks for stepping in. :raised_hands:
Recruiting: Backfill JD link will go into #hiring later today.
Alex Chen: Thanks all — chat with folks individually over the next 48h.
